# Setup

Install `dodo` (if needed):

```{r install-dodo}
remotes::install_github("Louis-Backstrom/dodo", quiet = TRUE)
```

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(dodo)
library(tidyverse)
library(future)
library(furrr)
library(ggh4x)

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

Get models:

```{r get-models}
models <- readxl::read_xlsx("EDE Papers.xlsx", sheet = 2, range = "D2:T50") %>%
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(`R?` == "✓") %>%
  pull(ID)
```

Set up parallel processing:

```{r setup-parallel}
plan(multisession, workers = floor(parallel::detectCores() * 0.75))
# plan(sequential)
```

Set key parameters:

```{r overwrite}
overwrite <- FALSE
```

```{r parameters}
eps <- 0.5
p_i <- 0.7
p_r <- 0.5

pse <- eps * p_i * p_r

extinction_time <- 100
alpha <- 0.05

iterations <- 1:25
test_times <- seq(50, extinction_time, by = 1)

grid <- expand.grid(iteration = iterations)
```

Set up functions for records, surveys, and effort:

```{r functions}
create_records <- function(extinction_time, pse, test_times) {
  records <- rpois(extinction_time, pse)
  records <- rep(seq_along(records), records)
  records <- data.frame(time = records, p_ci_min = 1, p_ci = 1, p_ci_max = 1)

  records <- map(test_times, ~ convert_dodo(records,
    init.time = 1,
    test.time = .x, threshold = 0.9, unique = FALSE,
    aggregate = "max", time = "time", certainty = "p_ci",
    certainty_lower = "p_ci_min", certainty_upper = "p_ci_max"
  ))

  return(records)
}

create_surveys <- function(test_time, eps, p_i, p_r) {
  surveys <- map(test_times, ~ tibble(
    time = 1:.x, survey = FALSE, epsilon = eps,
    epsilon_lower = eps, epsilon_upper = eps, p_i = p_i, p_i_lower = p_i,
    p_i_upper = p_i, p_r = p_r, p_r_lower = p_r, p_r_upper = p_r
  ))

  return(surveys)
}

create_effort <- function(test_time, eps) {
  effort <- map(test_times, ~ rep(eps, .x))

  return(effort)
}
```

Set up functions for models:

```{r model-functions}
run_model <- function(model, records, surveys, effort, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "SL88F1" = SL88F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SS89F1" = SS89F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SS89B1" = SS89B1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, length.out = 1e4,
      scale = 0.01
    ),
    "SO93F1" = SO93F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "SO93B1" = SO93B1(
      records = records$ccon, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, pi = 0.5
    ),
    "SO93F2" = SO93F2(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, precBits = 1024
    ),
    "MA94F1" = MA94F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, gamma = 0.5),
    "BU95F1" = BU95F1(records = records$cdis),
    "BU95F2" = BU95F2(records = records$cdis),
    "BU95F3" = BU95F3(records = records$cdis),
    "MA97F1" = MA97F1(
      records = records$cdis, effort = effort, alpha = alpha,
      init.time = 1
    ),
    "MC98F1" = MC98F1(records = records$cdis, effort = effort),
    "MC99F1" = MC99F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "WM99B1" = WM99B1(
      records = records$cbin, surveys = 1:test_time,
      alpha = alpha, test.time = test_time, priors = list(
        lambda = 1e3, c = 1, d = 1
      ), increment = 0.01
    ),
    "RS03F1" = RS03F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      conf.int = "one-sided", k = ifelse(length(
        records$ccon
      ) >= 10, 10, length(records$ccon)),
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "SR03F1" = SR03F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "MC06F1" = MC06F1(records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1),
    "RO09B1" = RO09B1(
      records = records$cbin, pi = 0.5, n.chains = 1,
      n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3
    ),
    "JE10F1" = JE10F1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "JE10F2" = JE10F2(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "BR12F1" = BR12F1(records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha),
    "SO12B1" = SO12B1(
      records = records$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.01,
      gamma = 1, record.check = "error"
    ),
    "TH13B1" = TH13B1(
      records = records$umcd,
      priors = list(p = list(p1 = 0.5), q = list(
        q1 = 1.0
      )), certain = c(1), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL
    ),
    "TH13B2" = TH13B2(
      records = records$umcd,
      priors = list(p = list(p1 = c(0, 1)), q = list(
        q1 = c(1, 1)
      )), certain = c(1), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL,
      n.iter = 10e3, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "TH13B3" = TH13B3(
      records = records$umcd,
      priors = list(p = list(p1 = c(0, 1)), q = list(
        q1 = c(1, 1)
      )), certain = c(1), PXT = NULL, PE = NULL,
      n.iter = 10e3, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "AL14B1" = AL14B1(records = records$cbin),
    "CB14B1" = CB14B1(
      records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "CB14B2" = CB14B2(
      records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, burn.in = 1e3, n.iter = 11e3
    ),
    "JR14F1" = JR14F1(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time
    ),
    "LE14B1" = LE14B1(
      records = records$iucn, surveys = surveys,
      threshold = 0.9, prior = c(0, 1), n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "LE14B2" = LE14B2(
      records = records$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3, n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "SB14B1" = SB14B1(records = records$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.01),
    "SB14B2" = SB14B2(records = records$ubin, init.time = 1, increment = 0.01),
    "AL15B1" = AL15B1(records = records$cbin),
    "SO16B1" = SO16B1(
      records = records$cbin, init.time = NULL,
      test.time = NULL, curr.time = NULL
    ),
    "SO16B2" = SO16B2(
      records = records$cbin, init.time = NULL,
      test.time = NULL, curr.time = NULL
    ),
    "WA16B1" = WA16B1(
      records = records$ccon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      use.mpfr = FALSE, cores = 1, pb = FALSE
    ),
    "TH17I1" = TH17I1(records = records$iucn, surveys = surveys),
    "BR19F1" = BR19F1(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F2" = BR19F2(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F3" = BR19F3(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F4" = BR19F4(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "BR19F5" = BR19F5(
      records = records$ucon, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.iter = 10e3
    ),
    "TH19B1" = TH19B1(
      records = records$iucn, surveys = surveys,
      init.time = max(records$ccon) + 1, test.time = test_time,
      pi = 0.5
    ),
    "KO20B1" = KO20B1(
      records = records$cbin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "KO20B2" = KO20B2(
      records = records$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
    "KO21B1" = KO21B1(
      records = records$ubin, alpha = alpha, init.time = 1,
      test.time = test_time, n.chains = 1, n.iter = 11e3,
      n.burnin = 1e3, n.thin = 10
    ),
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}

test_model <- function(model, output, alpha, test_time) {
  out <- switch(model,
    "SL88F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "SS89F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "SS89B1" = output$cred.int[2] < test_time,
    "SO93F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "SO93B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO93F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MA94F1" = output$conf.int[3] < test_time,
    "BU95F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BU95F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BU95F3" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MA97F1" = output$conf.int[2] < test_time,
    "MC98F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MC99F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "WM99B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "RS03F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "SR03F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "MC06F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "RO09B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "JE10F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "JE10F2" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "BR12F1" = output$estimate < test_time,
    "SO12B1" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "TH13B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH13B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH13B3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "AL14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "CB14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "CB14B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "JR14F1" = output$p.value < alpha,
    "LE14B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "LE14B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SB14B1" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "SB14B2" = output$Bayes.factor > (1 / alpha),
    "AL15B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO16B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "SO16B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "WA16B1" = output$cred.int[2] < test_time,
    "TH17I1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F3" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F4" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "BR19F5" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "TH19B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO20B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO20B2" = output$p.extant < alpha,
    "KO21B1" = output$p.extant < alpha,
  )

  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Unknown model name: ", model)
  }

  return(out)
}
```

Set up output directory:

```{r directory}
dir.create(file.path("Outputs", "A", "Extant"),
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)
```

# Run

Generate datasets:

```{r generate-datasets}
set.seed(1234)

rse_data <- grid %>%
  mutate(data = pmap(
    list(iteration),
    function(iteration) {
      records <- create_records(extinction_time, pse, test_times)
      surveys <- create_surveys(test_times, eps, p_i, p_r)
      effort <- create_effort(test_times, eps)

      return(list(records = records, surveys = surveys, effort = effort))
    }
  ))

stopifnot(nrow(rse_data) == nrow(grid))
saveRDS(rse_data, "Outputs/A/Extant/simulated_datasets.rds")
```

Run models:

```{r run-models}
run_grid <- expand.grid(
  iteration = iterations,
  test_time = test_times
)

if (file.exists("Outputs/A/Extant/model_times.rds")) {
  model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/A/Extant/model_times.rds")
} else {
  model_times <- tibble(
    model = character(), run_time = numeric(),
    end_time = POSIXct()
  )
}

for (model in models) {
  model_start <- Sys.time()
  model_ran <- FALSE

  model_file <- file.path("Outputs", "A", "Extant", paste0(model, ".rds"))

  valid_file <- FALSE
  if (file.exists(model_file)) {
    check <- readRDS(model_file)
    if (!is.null(check$results) && nrow(check$results) == nrow(run_grid)) {
      valid_file <- TRUE
    }
    rm(check)
  }

  if (!valid_file || overwrite == TRUE) {
    model_ran <- TRUE

    results <- future_map(seq_len(nrow(run_grid)), function(idx) {
      iteration <- run_grid$iteration[idx]
      test_time <- run_grid$test_time[idx]

      data_i <- rse_data$data[[iteration]]
      records <- data_i$records[[match(test_time, test_times)]]
      surveys <- data_i$surveys[[match(test_time, test_times)]]
      effort <- data_i$effort[[match(test_time, test_times)]]

      iteration_start <- Sys.time()

      warning_msg <- character()
      error_msg <- NA_character_

      output <- tryCatch(
        withCallingHandlers(
          run_model(
            model = model, records = records, surveys = surveys,
            effort = effort, alpha = alpha, test_time = test_time
          ),
          warning = function(w) {
            warning_msg <<- c(warning_msg, conditionMessage(w))
            invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
          }
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          error_msg <<- conditionMessage(e)
          NULL
        }
      )

      i_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), iteration_start, units = "secs") %>%
        as.numeric()

      result <- if (is.null(output)) {
        tibble(
          model = model, iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time,
          last_time = max(records$ccon), isextinct = NA,
          warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = TRUE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            tbl <- table(warning_msg)
            paste0(names(tbl), " (x", as.integer(tbl), ")", collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = if (length(error_msg) > 0) {
            tbl <- table(error_msg)
            paste0(names(tbl), " (x", as.integer(tbl), ")", collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          }, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      } else {
        tibble(
          model = model, iteration = iteration, test_time = test_time,
          last_time = max(records$ccon), isextinct = test_model(
            model, output, alpha, test_time
          ),
          warning = length(warning_msg) > 0, error = FALSE,
          warning_msg = if (length(warning_msg) > 0) {
            tbl <- table(warning_msg)
            paste0(names(tbl), " (x", as.integer(tbl), ")", collapse = " | ")
          } else {
            NA_character_
          },
          error_msg = NA_character_, run_time = i_time, end_time = Sys.time()
        )
      }

      rm(output)
      gc()

      return(result)
    }, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

    all_results <- bind_rows(results)

    saveRDS(list(model = model, results = all_results), model_file)
  }

  if (model_ran == TRUE) {
    m_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), model_start, units = "secs"))

    model_times <- model_times %>%
      filter(model != !!model) %>%
      bind_rows(tibble(
        model = model, run_time = m_time,
        end_time = Sys.time()
      ))
  }

  gc()
}

saveRDS(model_times, "Outputs/A/Extant/model_times.rds")
```

# Finish

Results:

```{r results}
model_files <- list.files("Outputs/A/Extant", pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("model_times\\.rds$", model_files)]
model_files <- model_files[!grepl("simulated_datasets\\.rds$", model_files)]

all_results <- map_dfr(model_files, function(model_file) {
  results_file <- readRDS(model_file)

  if (!is.null(results_file$results)) {
    results_file$results
  } else {
    warning("No results in ", basename(model_file))
    NULL
  }
})

model_times <- readRDS("Outputs/A/Extant/model_times.rds")
total_time <- sum(model_times$run_time) / 60
cat(sprintf("Total model execution time: %.2f minutes\n", total_time))
```

# Runtime

```{r runtime}
#| fig-dpi: 300
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
ggplot(model_times) +
  geom_col(aes(x = factor(model, levels = models), y = run_time / 60)) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Total Runtime (min)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

ggplot(model_times) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = "", y = run_time / 60, fill = factor(model, levels = models)),
    stat = "identity", width = 1, colour = "black"
  ) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  labs(fill = "Model") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title.align = 0.5) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    title.position = "top", ncol = 3, keywidth = 0.5,
    keyheight = 0.5
  ))
```

# Accuracy

```{r accuracy}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 8
models <- readxl::read_xlsx("EDE Papers.xlsx", sheet = 2, range = "D2:T50") %>%
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") %>%
  pull(ID)

any_custom <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA)
  } else {
    return(any(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
}

all_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

accuracy <- all_results %>%
  group_by(model, iteration) %>%
  summarise(
    any_is_na = any(is.na(isextinct)),
    any_wrong = any_custom(isextinct)
  ) %>%
  group_by(model, any_is_na, any_wrong) %>%
  tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(expand_grid(
    any_is_na = c(TRUE, FALSE),
    any_wrong = c(TRUE, NA, FALSE)
  ), .) %>%
  mutate(combined = paste(any_is_na, any_wrong, sep = " + ")) %>%
  filter(combined != "FALSE + NA") %>%
  mutate(
    combined = factor(combined, levels = c(
      "FALSE + FALSE", "TRUE + FALSE", "TRUE + NA", "TRUE + TRUE", "FALSE + TRUE"
    )),
    n = replace_na(n, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(-c(any_is_na, any_wrong))

excluded <- tibble(model = "AL14B2") %>%
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = models))

accuracy_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_bar(
    data = accuracy,
    aes(x = model, y = n, fill = combined),
    stat = "identity"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = excluded,
    aes(x = model, y = max(iterations) / 2, label = "Excluded"),
    fontface = "italic",
    angle = 90
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "FALSE + FALSE" = "#90EE90", "TRUE + FALSE" = "#49A749",
      "TRUE + NA" = "#808080", "TRUE + TRUE" = "#DB5765",
      "FALSE + TRUE" = "#F67280"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "FALSE + FALSE" = "Always Extant (no NAs)",
      "TRUE + FALSE" = "Always Extant (some NAs)",
      "TRUE + NA" = "Unknown (all NAs)",
      "TRUE + TRUE" = "Sometimes Extinct (some NAs)",
      "FALSE + TRUE" = "Sometimes Extinct (no NAs)"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, family = "mono",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.line = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Model",
    y = "Iterations",
    title = "Did the model correctly infer persistence at all time points?",
    fill = ""
  )

accuracy_plot

accuracy_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = all_results %>%
      mutate(
        isextinct = factor(isextinct),
        isextinct = fct_na_value_to_level(isextinct, "NA")
      ),
    aes(x = test_time, y = iteration, fill = isextinct)
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = excluded,
    label = "Excluded", x = (max(test_times) + min(test_times)) / 2,
    y = max(iterations) / 2, fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#F67280", "FALSE" = "#90EE90", "NA" = "#808080"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Extinct", "FALSE" = "Extant", "NA" = "NA or Error")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", axis.line = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Time",
    y = "Iteration",
    title = "Did the model correctly infer persistence?",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~model, drop = FALSE, ncol = 8, nrow = 6, axes = "all")

accuracy_plot

accuracy_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = all_results %>%
      group_by(model, test_time) %>%
      summarise(accuracy = mean(!isextinct, na.rm = TRUE)),
    aes(x = test_time, y = accuracy)
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = excluded,
    label = "Excluded", x = (max(test_times) + min(test_times)) / 2,
    y = 0.5, fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(family = "mono", face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Test Time",
    y = "Accuracy"
  )
```

```{r accuracy-portrait}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12
accuracy_plot +
  facet_wrap2(~model, drop = FALSE, ncol = 6, nrow = 8, 
             axes = "all", remove_labels = "all")
```

```{r accuracy-landscape}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 8
accuracy_plot +
  facet_wrap2(~model, drop = FALSE, ncol = 8, nrow = 6, 
             axes = "all", remove_labels = "all")
```

# Errors, Warnings, etc.

```{r issues}
all_results %>%
  filter(is.na(warning_msg) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(model, warning_msg) %>%
  tally()

all_results %>%
  filter(is.na(error_msg) == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(model, error_msg) %>%
  tally()
```
